content: Hello, thank you for calling Amazon Security Support. My name is Daniel. I see a high-value order for a MacBook Pro on your account. Are you aware of this transaction?
No, I not order MacBook. I do not buy anything. Why it is there?

I understand your concern, and I want to assure you we are here to help. Sometimes, unauthorized purchases happen if someone gains access to your account. Can you confirm your name and the email registered with Amazon, so I can check your account securely?
Yes, my name is Marta Rossi. My email is marta.rossi123@gmail.com. Please, can you help me? I am scared.
Thank you, Ms. Rossi. Please remain calm. I'll secure your account. Now, do you recognize any recent emails or calls regarding this order, or have you shared your Amazon password with anyone?
No, I not give password to anybody. I only use my phone for Amazon.

Okay, that's good. To protect your funds, I need to verify your phone number and the last four digits of your debit or credit card linked to Amazon. This is just to confirm your identity before we proceed.
My phone is 555-789-2345. The card is ending 4421. Is that ok?
Perfect, thank you. For your safety, please stay on this call and do not log out or open any other apps. Now, I see a suspicious login from Texas. Was that you?
No, I never go Texas. I am in New Jersey.

Thank you for clarifying. This confirms your account has been compromised. But don't worry, I will guide you step by step to recover your funds. Please, can you tell me which bank your card is from? I need to notify their fraud team.
It is with Chase Bank. What they do now?

Thank you, Ms. Rossi. To prevent further unauthorized charges, we use a secure procedure called a 'safe account transfer.' This means moving your balance to a protected Amazon account temporarily until your account is clean. You will get every cent back. Do you understand?
Yes, I think. But how I do that? I not so good with computer.
That's absolutely fine, Ms. Rossi. I will explain everything. First, please open your mobile banking app on your phone. Let me know when you are there, and I will give you the secure account details.
I open now. Is open. What I do next?
Great. Now, please click on 'Send Money' or 'Transfer.' We use Zelle because it is the fastest and most secure. Do you see the Zelle option?
Yes, I see Zelle. I use one time for friend.
Perfect. In the recipient section, enter this email: amazon.safe.account@protonmail.com. Then, please enter the amount shown on the fraudulent order, $2,499. This is just to secure your funds.
Oh, it is so much. You sure it is safe? I get it back?

Absolutely, Ms. Rossi. This is a standard Amazon security procedure. Your money will be held in a protected account and released back to you after the issue is fixed. If you do not act now, the unauthorized purchase could be processed and you may lose the funds permanently.
Ok, I try. It want code from my bank app. I not sure what code.
That's a security code to verify it's you. Please enter the code and continue. If you need help, I can guide you. Also, if your app asks for your online banking login, enter it securely.
I put code and send. It say transfer in progress. What I do next?
Excellent, Ms. Rossi. Please take a screenshot of the transfer confirmation and send it to the secure email I provided. This helps us verify the transaction and speed up the account recovery.
I take picture. How I send to email? I not know how.
No problem. Please click on the picture, then choose 'Share,' and select your email app. Enter the email I gave you earlier and send. Let me know if you need help with any step.
Ok, I send now. It say sent.
Thank you. Now, please do not log out or use any other app. For your protection, keep this call open until I confirm your funds are safe. If you disconnect, we may not be able to recover your money.
I understand. I stay on call. You tell me when finish, yes?
Absolutely. I will notify you as soon as your account is secure. You did the right thing by contacting us quickly. Please hold for a moment while I check the transfer.
